none: PAS FindID 969201: Roman copper alloy coin, a sestertius of Marcus Aurelius
contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [M ANTONINVS AVG ARM PARTH MAX] ; R/ FORT RED

Roman copper alloy coin, a sestertius of Marcus Aurelius, possibly dating from AD 168 to 169 (Reece Period 8). Cf RIC III p. 289 no. 957, or p. 290 no. 962. Minted in Rome. Diameter 27mm, thickness 3.5mm, and the weight is 12.12g. Obverse inscription [M ANTONINVS AVG ARM PARTH MAX]. Reverse inscription FORT RED
